faq.a: LX Software is an independent software studio in Hong Kong. I design and build web software, then look after it.

faq.q: How do I get in touch?
faq.a: Use the Contact Me section: telephone, email, WhatsApp, or WeChat, whichever is configured. Email reaches hello@lx-software.com.

faq.q: Does this site collect email addresses?
faq.a: No. There is no newsletter signup and no account. If you write, call, or message, that conversation is used only to reply.

sections.heading: Who
paragraphs: This site is published by LX Software, an independent studio in Hong Kong. The contact mailbox is hello@lx-software.com.

sections.heading: What this site collects
paragraphs: The site does not run accounts, comments, or a newsletter. It does not ask you to create a profile.
The host keeps ordinary server logs (IP address, user agent, requested URL, and time) to operate and secure the site. Those logs are not used for advertising.

sections.heading: When you get in touch
paragraphs: If you email, call, or message through the contact links, I use that conversation to reply. I do not sell it and I do not add you to a mailing list.

sections.heading: Cookies and media
paragraphs: This site does not set advertising cookies. The harbour video is decoration. It has no audio and carries no extra tracking pixel of its own. It is served from this site, or from media.lx-software.com when that host is configured.
